name: Half-Wood Elf
desc: Humans with wood elf blood: light-footed, at home in the wilds and able to hear the voice of the forest.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.desc: You have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Charmed condition.

traits.name: Woodland Training
traits.desc: You gain proficiency in either the Nature or Survival skill.

traits.name: Voice of the Wild
traits.desc: You always have Speak with Animals and Speak with Plants prepared. You can cast each spell once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast them in this way when you finish a Long Rest. You can also cast either spell using any spell slots you have.
